description:
Perform a negative spatial selection in gvSIG Desktop to identify 'isolated' territories.

Goal: Create a shapefile containing only the countries that do NOT contain any populated places (cities).

1. Launch gvSIG Desktop (if not open).
2. Create a new View and load two shapefiles:
   - Countries: /home/ga/gvsig_data/countries/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp
   - Populated Places: /home/ga/gvsig_data/cities/ne_110m_populated_places.shp
3. Use the 'Selection by Layer' tool (View > Selection > Selection by layer) to select features in the Countries layer that are DISJOINT from (do not intersect) the Populated Places layer. 
   (Alternatively, select intersecting features and then invert the selection).
4. Verify your selection visually: Large countries like USA or China should NOT be selected. Small island nations should be selected.
5. Export the selected features to a new shapefile located at: /home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/isolated_territories.shp

The task is complete when the exported shapefile exists and contains the correct subset of countries.
